description: This file defines an Android activity (`AddEditTradeActivity`) for adding or editing trade records in a trading journal app. It includes UI initialization, data loading for existing trades, form validation, and saving trade data to local storage.

classes.name: AddEditTradeActivity
classes.description: An Android activity class for adding or editing trade entries in a trading journal application, handling user input, data validation, and database operations.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and loads existing trade data if editing.

methods.name: setupSpinner
methods.description: Configures a spinner with a provided list of string items.

methods.name: showDatePicker
methods.description: Displays a date picker dialog and sets the selected date in a TextInputEditText.

methods.name: loadExistingTrade
methods.description: Loads trade data from the database asynchronously for editing.

methods.name: populateFields
methods.description: Populates the form fields with data from an existing trade object.

methods.name: saveTrade
methods.description: Validates user input, constructs a Trade object, and saves it to the database asynchronously.
